requires.why: v2.8 09 D gate: the Help panel's Ask box, open with an answer rendered, in player mode. The answer is planted (storyOrchestratorDebugAskResponse), so no model is called; the real-model Q&A is the CL row.

import_story.title: SO-V28-09 Ask
import_story.description: v2.8 09: player Ask over a story with an unreached turning point.
import_story.player_intro: You arrive at the hall at night.

qualities.rubric: Does the player know who the traitor is?

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugAskResponse = JSON.stringify({ answer: 'You are in The Hall. I can only talk about what you have played so far.', topics: ['feature/story-drawer', 'st/lorebook-activation'] }); return true;

const outcome = await globalThis.storyOrchestratorAsk.ask('Who is the traitor?'); if (!outcome.ok) throw new Error('ask failed: ' + outcome.reason); if (outcome.persona !== 'player') throw new Error('expected player Ask in player mode, got ' + outcome.persona); const ids = outcome.result.topics.map((topic) => topic.id); if (ids.includes('st/lorebook-activation')) throw new Error('player Ask kept an author topic: ' + ids.join(',')); return { persona: outcome.persona, topics: ids, showMe: outcome.result.showMe };
